author: BajuBesi Labs
name: Jukebox
short: A music player panel with buttons, on top of Red's Audio cog.
description: A Now Playing panel with buttons for previous, pause, skip, seek, loop, shuffle, volume, filters, queue, grab, like and autoplay. Requires Red's built-in Audio cog to be loaded.
install_msg: Jukebox installed. Load Red's Audio cog first (`[p]load audio`), then `[p]load jukebox` and post the panel with `[p]jukebox setup` in your music channel.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the jukebox panel's channel and message per server, and the songs each user likes (the Like button) under their Discord user id.
